pairs.subject: ipc-contract
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-types/src/rpc.rs:268 The RPC params types (RunFilter, RunParams, RunsPageParams and the rest in rpc.rs) have no `deny_unknown_fields` and are all-optional, and the daemon decodes them with plain `serde_json::from_value`, so a mis-cased key such as `{"filter":{"toneVariant":"x"}}` quietly turns into `None` and `runs.page` comes back unfiltered: the silent-null failure that casing-and-naming says to refuse at development-time boundaries.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-types/src/schema.rs:208 The engine authors the types. They become one committed JSON Schema marked do-not-edit, with one regeneration command, and a method -> {params,result} binding table (`RpcMethods`) is generated with it. Gap: the non-method types in `wire_types()` are listed by hand, so a type can be serialized without the contract describing it.

crates/shadowrunr-types/tests/schema_drift.rs:8 The cargo test rebuilds the schema in-process and compares it with the committed file read from disk (CRLF-normalized). A missing or untracked file panics, and output is one monolithic file, so no orphans can hide inside it. The test does not take an inventory of the schema directory, so a stray extra file there would go unseen. The second hop (schema -> TS) is gated in packages/contract, outside this context.

crates/shadowrunr-types/src/error.rs:14 Closed list of ten codes (`ALL`) in a `{error:{code,message,detail?}}` envelope (error.rs:111). Both go out through the schema export, and the legacy names are kept apart in `from_legacy` (error.rs:78). Weak spot: there is no `forbidden` class, and `forbidden_origin` is folded into `invalid_params` with the difference carried only in `detail.reason`.

crates/shadowrunr-types/src/rpc.rs:542 One method table feeds both the schema's name set and `method_names()` (rpc.rs:625), and the daemon's dispatch-parity test reads `method_names()`. An unknown method has its own code, `MethodNotFound` (error.rs:21), so the near side need not detect it from message text.

crates/shadowrunr-types/src/rpc.rs:268 Field names are native snake_case, and the enum value exceptions are listed in contract.md. But strict decoding (`deny_unknown_fields`, e.g. catalog.rs:76) is used only on character/config manifests, never on RPC params types, so mis-cased optional params arrive as None without any error. Enum casing is also set per type (snake_case/lowercase/UPPERCASE) rather than in one place.
crates/shadowrunr-types/Cargo.toml:3 This crate holds types only and has no call sites. The single call wrapper and its timeout classes belong on the console side.

pairs.registryProposal: casing-and-naming says to configure the wire casing in 'a global serializer setting, not per-type annotations', but serde has no crate-wide rename setting. In a serde-authored contract, per-type `rename_all` on enums is forced, so the technique should name the substitute: a test or lint asserting that every enum carries the declared casing.
